'''Spice Terminus''' was a space station in [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]], at the end of the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]].

==History==
Spice Terminus was a major hub in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade because it was near the intersection of the Llanic Spice Run and the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
